name: ZeroBench
intro: ZeroBench是一个轻量级的视觉推理基准，旨在评估大型多模态模型（LMMs）的视觉理解能力。该基准由100个精心策划的问题和334个较简单的子问题组成，旨在挑战现有LMMs的极限。通过对20个LMMs进行评估，所有模型得分均为0.0%，揭示了它们在视觉解释方面的不足。ZeroBench的发布旨在推动视觉理解领域的进步。
org: University of Cambridge, University of Alberta, Independent Researcher, The University of Hong Kong,
eval_feature: 轻量级, 多样性, 高质量, 手动策划, 零样本
eval_feature_en: Lightweight, Diversity, High Quality, Manually Curated, Zero-shot
intro_en: ZeroBench is a lightweight visual reasoning benchmark designed to evaluate the visual understanding capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs). It consists of 100 carefully curated questions and 334 simpler sub-questions, aimed at pushing the limits of existing LMMs. Evaluations of 20 LMMs all resulted in scores of 0.0%, revealing their shortcomings in visual interpretation. The release of ZeroBench aims to advance the field of visual understanding.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ZeroBench arXiv:2502.09696v3, Sections 3.1-3.3, Table 1, Sections 4.1-4.2, Table 2, and Appendix F; official project https://zerobench.github.io/, repository https://github.com/jonathan-roberts1/zerobench, and dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/jonathan-roberts1/zerobench. Version pin: paper construction creates v1 then community-red-team v2, and paper experiments use v2; the current project v3 only clarifies two main questions and three associated subquestions without changing scores.. More than 20 creators hand-craft 140 difficult visual candidates, iteratively improve them with o1 pro/QVQ probes, and submit them to independent review that broadens answer spaces and removes unsuitable formats. Adversarial filtering removes any candidate solved by any baseline, leaving 100 v1 questions; subquestions are derived from natural reasoning steps. Community red-teaming modifies 23% into v2, followed by a clarity-only v3 patch. Evaluation uses brace-delimited final answers, exact match, macro subquestion scoring, pass@k, and pass^k.
